about.title: About
about.subtitle: DavIT Futures is Dawid Domagała's software company. You work directly with the senior engineer who designs and builds your product: no account managers, no hand-offs, no juniors learning on your budget.
about.name: Dawid Domagała
about.role: Founder · senior .NET and Angular engineer, team lead
facts: 18+ years in banking, trading, medtech and SaaS
MSc in Electronics, Wrocław University of Technology

items.title: Finance and trading
items.text: We know trading from the inside: IG Group's L2 Dealer Level 2 desktop platform and WTP web trading platform, risk engines at Credit Suisse and mutual fund distribution. We speak the language of your market, not just code.

items.title: Quality and security
items.text: Automated tests on every change, quality gates that block regressions and security held to banking standards. Corporate rigour without corporate slowness.

items.title: DevOps and pipelines
items.text: We build CI/CD pipelines end to end: one-click releases, 24/7 zero-downtime deployments, automated code signing and release notes.

items.title: Speed through AI
items.text: AI agents speed up delivery, and a human reviews and tests every change. Your code and data stay under your control: AI tools are used only within your security policies.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: From idea and prototype to production release and maintenance.

items.title: Web applications
items.text: Modern apps in Angular, Blazor, React and Vue.js: responsive, fast and easy to extend as your business grows.

items.title: Backend and APIs
items.text: C# .NET and Java APIs (REST, GraphQL), microservices, MS SQL and PostgreSQL. Built for performance and stability under load.

items.title: Mobile applications
items.text: Xamarin and Vue.js with Quasar and Cordova. One codebase for mobile, web and desktop, so there is less to maintain.

items.title: Desktop and legacy modernisation
items.text: WPF, WinForms and DevExpress. We modernise legacy systems and move them to current technology without stopping the business.

items.title: Multi-tenant SaaS
items.text: White-label products with tenant data isolation and per-customer configuration and branding.

items.title: DevOps and CI/CD
items.text: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines, automated releases, code signing, Docker and Azure.

items.title: AI adoption in teams
items.text: We bring AI agents into your delivery process, with trainings and workshops for your developers.

process.title: How we work
process.subtitle: A simple, transparent way to start and to deliver.

steps.title: Free 30-minute call
steps.text: We talk about your goals, constraints and timeline. No obligation.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.text: You get the scope, an estimate and a fixed-price or time-and-materials offer.

steps.title: Short iterations
steps.text: A working demo every one or two weeks, so you see progress and can steer early.

steps.title: Release and support
steps.text: CI/CD, documentation and handover, plus maintenance when you need it.

process.footnote: B2B contracts · remote or on site · CET time zone · Polish and English

tech.title: Technology
tech.subtitle: The stack behind the projects below.

groups.name: AI

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Selected commercial projects from the last 18 years, and this website.

items.name: L2 Dealer
items.description: Level 2 desktop trading platform. We rebuilt the delivery process end to end: a GitLab CI/CD pipeline (17k+ lines), GitFlow with release branches and merge requests, quality gates and large refactors of core modules, reaching a HIGH app maturity rating. We also delivered “Price In Size”, part of a company-wide initiative that earned £15M in its first month.

items.name: Risk engine platforms: LTV, PRC and PRIIPs
items.description: Silverlight to Angular 10 migration with a GraphQL backend, monolith split into .NET Core microservices, multithreaded risk calculations, MS SQL tuning and query speed-ups, regulatory KID documents (PRIIPs) with BDD tests across the whole API.
items.outcome: Silverlight → Angular · 100% of the API covered by BDD tests

items.name: QiaCuity and QiaGuest
items.description: UI for a digital PCR (dPCR) instrument that counts DNA copies for medical diagnostics, in React/Redux on Linux. Plus QiaGuest, a reception app built from scratch in Angular and .NET Core on Azure.
items.outcome: QiaGuest built from scratch on Azure

items.name: Focis
items.description: Multi-tenant SaaS for law firms, built end to end by one engineer and later joined by a second developer: document workflow, dynamic forms, tenant data isolation, push notifications and SMS login.

items.name: InCenter and InTire
items.description: Fleet management with tyre-pressure monitoring. A Wi-Fi router on each truck collected TPMS sensor data, including the low-level sensor communication we wrote, and uploaded it to a central server, where a web app managed the whole fleet.
items.outcome: 2-week proof of concept that won the contract

items.name: White-label spirometry
items.description: Lung-function diagnostics for clinics and clinical trials, branded for each pharma partner under medical-device regulation.

items.name: Elemos
items.description: Software for the waste and recycling industry: a WPF office app and an in-truck app on Windows Mobile handhelds, later migrated to Xamarin, with RFID, route planning and live vehicle tracking.

items.name: Goniec Online
items.description: A large, complex mutual fund distribution system deployed in many Polish banks: buying and selling fund units and setting up distribution networks.

items.name: DavIT Futures website
items.description: This website: Blazor WebAssembly on .NET 10, two languages, light and dark themes, automatic deployment to GitHub Pages with GitHub Actions.

testimonials.title: What people say
testimonials.subtitle: A recommendation from LinkedIn, quoted in full.

items.quote:
Dawid is an excellent senior developer and a great team player. While working on same projects, Dawid has shown knowledge, will and proactive approach to problem solving. He was working on multiple tasks across multiple products and he always made an impact. Dawid also did great improvements to our delivery pipeline. He is willing to work on demanding tasks and always willing to take responsibility.

I would strongly recommend Dawid as I believe he can bring value to any team. Dawid is also a great person and always happy to help.
items.author: Miroslav Vrbanac
items.role: Full Stack Developer, Asset Management Technology, Director at UBS
